description: In outbound.rs deliver_article, one JoinSet task is spawned per follower with no upper bound. A group with 10,000 followers will spawn 10,000 concurrent HTTP connection attempts simultaneously. This can exhaust file descriptors, connection pool limits, or memory. A semaphore or bounded concurrency (e.g. max 50 concurrent deliveries) is needed to prevent resource exhaustion during fanout.
title: deliver_article fanout: no cap on concurrent delivery tasks
